'''Kor Vosadii''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Vosadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]].
